My Dearest Nemesis

그놈은 흑염룡

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2025

⭐☆☆☆☆1B/10

Overview

Baek Su-jeong and Ban Ju-yeon first meet through an online game as teenagers, then unexpectedly reunite 16 years later as employee and boss. Neither initially realizes that the person they are meeting again is the same person from their past. As their feelings return, they are also forced to confront the childhood wounds that shaped them.

My Review

I really laughed most of the time. This series was too good and so fun to watch. At first, I thought Su-jeong's reaction toward Ju-yeon was worse because of the harsh words she said to him after he confessed, but as more of their past was revealed, I understood her better. I realized that she didn't really hate Ju-yeon—she was hurting because of everything she had experienced. Su-jeong was forced to become strong after losing her mother, and she felt responsible for her father and younger brother. I understood why she wanted someone mature whom she could finally rely on instead of always having to be the strong one. I also really felt for Ju-yeon. After losing his parents in an accident, he was mistreated and blamed by his grandmother. He was still so young, but he was forced to suppress his sadness and become a replacement for his father. He even blamed himself for the accident because of the things he thought he could have done differently. I really admired how both Ban Ju-yeon and Baek Su-jeong endured everything they went through. I loved the main four characters—Ban Ju-yeon, Baek Su-jeong, Seo Ha-jin, and Kim Shin-won. I also liked Su-jeong's father and younger brother, Subin. I especially loved how competent Su-jeong was when she was accused of seducing Director Ban just to be promoted. She didn't need anyone to make her successful because she was already capable of doing the job herself. The ending was very satisfying. Ju-yeon and Su-jeong ended up together, and Ha-jin and Shin-won also got their happy ending. I laughed a lot, cried a little, and really enjoyed watching their story. The scene that made me cry the most was when Ju-yeon's grandmother finally realized everything and apologized to him. After everything he went through, that apology felt deserved. Overall, definitely worth watching.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Ju-yeon's grandmother finally realizing what she had done and apologizing to him. After seeing how Ju-yeon was treated after losing his parents, this scene gave me the most emotional satisfaction. It felt like he finally received the acknowledgment he had been waiting for. • Ju-yeon and Su-jeong realizing their first love was actually each other.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"Instead of worrying about other people, I'll do what truly makes me happy."
